title: Businesses are using more AI and paying less for it, Ramp AI Index shows
key_facts: The latest Ramp AI Index, from Ramp economist Ara Kharazian, shows US companies spending less on AI.
Kharazian points to price cuts on top models and cheaper, more efficient standard and lite models, and says the drop comes almost entirely from competition between OpenAI and Anthropic.
Usage has climbed about 50% since spending peaked in July and hit a record high at the end of September.
Open-source models make up less than 5% of business spending.
In the last week of September covered by the data, Anthropic took 51% of token spending and OpenAI 44.5%.
The index tracks transaction data from more than 70,000 US companies; token data comes from a subsample; it covers only API spending and skews toward large AI customers.
The Decoder notes this is not the first decline but has lasted unusually long.
